column1: # FIX-1164 — role-ineligible officials carrying an FEC CAND_ID they cannot hold, with ZERO fec_bulk money.
# Derived on the LOCAL CLONE 2026-09-07. 55 officials, 2 of them is_active.
# WHY THIS IS A SEPARATE MANIFEST FROM FIX-1153's. The FIX-1153 population is
# MONEY-keyed: role cannot hold an FEC office AND holds fec_bulk-sourced
# financial_relationships rows. These 55 satisfy the role half and hold no money
# at all, so the money-keyed predicate correctly does not return them — which is
# exactly the set difference the FIX-1153 dry run reported against the id-keyed
# FIX-937 manifests, and why that difference was a predicate property rather
# They still need remediating: the stored fec_id is the thing that hands the slot
# back to the next FEC run and re-monies the wrong official. The remediation is
# the id-retire step ALONE (source_ids fec_id -> misattributed_fec_id); there are
# no rows to delete and no donors to re-roll up, which is why the money columns
# below are all zero. The role-ineligible script's retire step is keyed on the
# OFFICIAL rather than on its rows, so these pass through it unchanged.
# The zero money columns are not padding: they are what the FIX-1165 clone-vs-prod
# diff compares against. A row here that shows rows > 0 on prod has acquired money
# since this was derived and will be REPORTED AND SKIPPED rather than swept in.
